title: RJ Harvey’s knee injury is not believed to be serious

sources.title: RJ Harvey’s knee injury is not believed to be serious
sources.description: The Denver Broncos ruled running back RJ Harvey out for their game against the Kansas City Chiefs, but with no word or comment on the severity of the knee injury he seemingly suffered in practice this week.
